_meta.rule: Each entry quotes or closely paraphrases a primary document and links to the exact page it came from. Nothing here is inferred from a blog post.

policies.title: You must state you are an Amazon Associate
policies.requirement: The Associates Program Operating Agreement §5 requires the statement "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases." (or a substantially similar statement previously allowed) to appear clearly and prominently on your site.
policies.how_this_site_complies: The exact sentence appears in the disclosure strip directly under the masthead on every page, and again in every page footer.
policies.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site …: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."

policies.title: Only tagged Special Links earn commission
policies.requirement: Every link to an Amazon Site must carry your Associates ID ('tag') as a URL parameter, and must be accessed directly from your site. Untagged links do not attribute.
policies.how_this_site_complies: Outbound links point at the supplied short links, which are the owner's enrolled link format. The gate asserts that every outbound Amazon link carries rel="sponsored" and is logged in the link register. Whether each short link actually carries the tag is unresolved — FLG-003.
policies.quote: Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you. … you must include your Associates ID or "tag" (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
policies.section: §2(b) General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links

policies.title: Prices may not be printed unless Amazon supplies them
policies.requirement: You may show price and availability only if (a) Amazon serves the link in which that data is displayed, or (b) you obtain the data via the Creators API or PA API and comply with the license. A static site satisfies neither.
policies.how_this_site_complies: No price or availability figure appears anywhere on this site. Each product card states the fact explicitly and explains why. See FLG-001.
policies.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.

policies.title: Do not make inaccurate or misleading product claims
policies.requirement: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about any product, an Amazon Site, or Amazon's policies, promotions or prices.
policies.how_this_site_complies: Every specification on a product page is tied to a field in the product register that carries its own source URL. Fields that could not be confirmed are printed as 'Not confirmed' rather than filled in. No superlatives about performance are asserted.
policies.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.

policies.title: Your site must be original content, publicly available
policies.requirement: A participating site must contain original content and be publicly available. Third-party material must carry significant commentary, analysis or transformation.
policies.how_this_site_complies: All editorial copy is written for this site. Product titles are quoted only as identification and are attributed to the listing they came from. No manufacturer photo, logo or marketing asset is reproduced.
policies.quote: Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application. Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation to any materials you include.

policies.title: Traffic must come from your own site, not from Amazon
policies.requirement: You must not post Special Links on Amazon, or link to your site from Amazon specifically to promote your Special Links. You also may not encourage customers to bookmark your Special Links.
policies.how_this_site_complies: Links are only published on this site and in its own RSS feed. Nothing is posted back to Amazon. The feed carries article links, not affiliate links.
policies.quote: You must not post any Special Links on Amazon or link to any page on your Site from Amazon specifically to promote your Special Links. … You must not encourage customers to bookmark your Special Links.

policies.title: Material connection must be disclosed — FTC
policies.requirement: A material connection between an endorser and the seller, not reasonably expected by the audience, must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously. Compensation in the form of commission is a material connection.
policies.applies_to: All editorial and every outbound link
policies.how_this_site_complies: Disclosure strip under the masthead on every page; repeated in the footer; a full disclosure page; and a one-line note next to every buy button.
policies.quote: When there exists a connection between the endorser and the seller of the advertised product that might materially affect the weight or credibility of the endorsement … such connection must be fully disclosed.
policies.document: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising, §255.5

policies.title: Endorsements must be honest and not distort reviews
policies.requirement: Endorsements must reflect the honest opinions and experience of the endorser, and advertisers must not take actions that distort what consumers think of their products.
policies.how_this_site_complies: This site publishes no star ratings of its own and no invented customer quotes. Where Amazon's own rating is shown it is labelled as Amazon's figure, stamped with an observation time, and presented with the trade-offs alongside.
policies.quote: Endorsements must reflect the honest opinions, findings, beliefs, or experience of the endorser. … advertisers should not take actions that have the effect of distorting or otherwise misrepresenting what consumers think of their products.
